control_attribution: Previously accepted Iris native default Scotch N=56 tree; comparison data are recomputed from its processor boundary files on the allocated compute node.

mesh_identity.scope: Full file size and SHA256 checks against the retained official archive extraction.

input_pins.provenance: Inherited canonical input file hashes from reviewed Iris full-case source and xzy initialization bundle. Runtime source is checked against the retained local payload and all pins before cut.

scotch_source.relevant_behavior: A nonempty processorWeights list takes precedence. Otherwise, domains plus domainWeights select SCOTCH_archTleaf. The implementation converts each domain weight to integer weight divided by the minimum weight; (1, 0.1) therefore becomes (10, 1).

hardware_and_rank_map.observed: Two packages x 28 physical cores; 56 Open MPI ranks bind 28 to package 0 and 28 to package 1.
hardware_and_rank_map.interpretation_limit: The observed package mapping justifies logical rank//28 grouping. Processor-boundary faces are not measured bytes, latency, bandwidth, page placement, or solver speed.
